crossRefs.note: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”
They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

translations.web: They began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.
translations.bsb: Then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this.
translations.kjv: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
translations.asv: And they began to question among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
